title: plectranthus bojeri
intro: Plectranthus bojeri, commonly known as the Cape Tease, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Plectranthus bojeri include antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
